title: Anyone been to this place?
content: Pic one: This is what my mall looks like in the “friendlier” sections. The floor is typically extremely polished. It feels somehow present day but also somehow not. There’s a sunset type glow throughout the dream. Pic two: Nightmare mall. escalators are very prominent. Some of them go very quickly with a gap in between platforms. most have no railings. The orange glow is more prominent here but it feels filthy and apocalyptic. Bathroom mazes are prominent. I feel like something is pursuing me and though I can never see it, it always seems to know where I am.
